method: Same machine and nine-stone workload as earlier reports (49 stones, seed 0 unless noted, 1024 iterations, mcts_cuda.yml, one BLAS/OpenMP thread, sequential fresh processes, search-only timing). Chunk-size rows use the benchmark overrides --placement-batch-size/--cuda-batch-size on the copy-optimized code.
changes: Action.copy copies pose arrays and deep-copies diagnostics once, without reconstructing and revalidating (it previously deep-copied diagnostics twice).
StackObjectTrajectory.copy of a list-based history returns the packed form, so later branch copies copy one array.
SimulationTransition batch steps return each newly built child state directly and keep one independent final snapshot per chunk.
MCTS short evaluations hand the evaluation's private state to the node (set_result owned=True) instead of copying it again; authoritative paths still copy.

transition_profile.note: Timer-only tests/profile_excavator_cuda_mcts.py, before copy changes vs after copy changes (both placement 32/native 128); inclusive seconds, overlapping rows; reward and voxel rows are worker thread sums.
